# Outbox loaded control follow-up

Predeclared for rebased #3085: A1/A2 main 551d4d0825dca64b7143d6f18fc2b13baaf1fe0a and B a7a73d076f8fd4590edf4d7d278e3a55d7cd3532. Previous run 34291743396 used A b19a9240e602ed70eb92ef515ded0eba7e42310a and B 00034f6529e4e18929821265bee73b80e12c9bdf, with a 20-second primer, 180-second warmup and 180-second measurement. PR comment 5594333774 records all absolute metrics, exact settings and INCONCLUSIVE verdict before this new experiment.

The previous legacy-listener-on p99 was 7.045/8.494/8.017 ms and maximum 18.632/25.023/21.976 ms. Controls drifted 13.79%/17.95%; 15–24 measured JIT methods included recurring producer maintenance and runtime helpers. The candidate maximum had no JIT event within one second. No causal product loss was established by those noisy tails, and no sample was discarded.

Keep all four legacy/renewal by listener-off/on configurations. Validate both products and every configuration before measuring. For each exact configuration, run A1, B, then A2 immediately on the same ubuntu-latest VM. Keep fresh broker/topic state, core affinity, product/fixture binding checks, record/batch inputs, producer settings, allocation/CPU scope and latency boundaries from PLAN.md. Retain the 20-second primer, extend continuous warmup to 480 seconds, and retain 180 seconds measurement. Record both the predeclared order and actual UTC capture boundaries. This reduces spacing between controls and exercises more recurring runtime activity before measurement; it does not waive runtime transitions or control drift that remain.

All original tolerances remain: 3% completed-throughput/CPU loss, 5% per-row completion-boundary p50/p99/max loss and 1 B/message allocation increase against both controls, with control drift assessed separately. Each 500-row batch shares its exposure-to-successful-MarkPublished boundary, so independent sample counts are batches, not rows. Preserve all raw cycles, maxima, JIT names, CPU/GC/heap/RSS/backlog samples and separate broker statistics. A successful workflow cannot set a PASS automatically.

This campaign refreshes the normal loaded matrix on the new exact head. It does not add error/lease-loss or loaded-shutdown scenarios, and it does not certify those paths. The earlier focused metric microbenchmarks, correctness tests and remaining scope limitations must be reviewed separately. No identical paid repeat or acceptance tradeoff is authorized by this plan.
